summary.en: Your film as glowing text on an old monochrome terminal.
summary.zh-CN: 你的片子变成一台老式单色终端上发光的文字画面。

details.en:
Best for: developer tools, sci-fi, tech brands, anything that wants a cold, patient, machine feel.
What it does: builds every image from real characters on a grid, lit like a 1980s CRT, with terminal-style typed subtitles.
details.zh-CN:
适合：开发者工具、科幻、科技品牌，想要冷静克制的机器感。
它会：用真实字符在网格上拼出每个画面，配上80年代CRT的发光效果和逐字打出的终端字幕。
